items.evidence: README's play command (--ticks 600 --seed 1 --settings ... --inputs 0:enter,1:shoot,...) printed one JSON object with tick, screen, menu_index, language, volume, difficulty, texts, score, best, coins, wave, gate_health, guard_y, quick, heavy, saved, enemies, bolts; --ticks 1 shows screen title.
--frame title.png --size 800x480 after a run wrote a PNG: 'PNG image data, 800 x 480, 8-bit/color RGBA'.
Fresh settings folder, tick 1: texts [name, 'Best: 0', Start, Settings, Quit], no Continue; 1:enter -> tick 2 screen play, wave 1, score 0, coins 0, gate_health 10.

Settings: right from 8 -> 9,10,10,10; left x12 -> 0 and stays 0; language right en->es->fr->fr (stops), left back to en; difficulty normal default, right->hard (stops), left->normal->easy (stops), right->normal.

es and fr runs: title, settings, play, paused, shop, lost texts all translated (e.g. 'Tienda','Albañil: puerta 5 de 10, 4 monedas','La porte est tombée : vous avez perdu','Entrée : titre'); only the game name stays English. Won screen not reached in play (see l21); its title line is in both tables and its other lines are the lost screen's, seen translated.
Run 1 set volume 3, French, Hard; run 2 with same --settings started at title with fr, 3, hard ('Meilleur : 0','Commencer'); a fresh folder starts en, 8, normal.
Holding up from tick 1: guard_y 6 -> 6.1 -> 7.1 (10 ticks) -> 9.1 -> 12 and stays 12; down reaches 0 and stays 0. 0.1/tick = 6 u/s on x = 2.
Shoot held from tick 11: bolts appear at ticks 12, 36, 60, 84 (every 24) at x=2; each moves 0.233/tick (14 u/s); bolt at 19.475 on tick 87 is gone 3 ticks later (past 20).
Seed 1: walkers enter x=20 at ticks 2, 92, 182, ... (90 ticks apart), lanes 6,2,6,6,2, health 2, x drops 0.025/tick (1.5 u/s); 5 in total (gate 10 -> 5 when all pass).
Lane-6 walker: tick 72 bolt reaches it, health 2->1 and the bolt is gone; second hit destroys it, score 0->10, coins 0->1. Bolts at y=5 flew past a walker at y=6 untouched.

No shooting: tick 801 walker at x 0.025, tick 802 gone, gate 10->9, score/coins 0. Hard run: wave 2 walkers bring gate to 0 -> screen lost, texts ['The gate has fallen: you lost','Score: 0','Best: 0','Enter: title'].
Difficulty Easy then Start: gate_health 14; Hard then Start: gate_health 7.

After wave 1's last walker passed (tick 1162): screen shop, enemies [], bolts []; texts ['Shop','Coins: 0','Next: wave 2 of 8','Quick hands: level 0 of 2, 5 coins','Heavy bolts: level 0 of 1, 12 coins','Mason: gate 5 of 10, 4 coins','Next wave']; state unchanged tick 1163..1300.
--set coins=40: quick 40->35 (level 1), ->25 (level 2), third Enter: still 25, level 2. Shoot held: quick 1 bolts 18 ticks apart (13,31,49,67); quick 2 bolts 12 apart (1194,1206,1218).
Heavy bought (12 coins); walker at health 2 hit by the first bolt at tick 1256 is destroyed (score +10, coin +1); second Enter on Heavy with 13 coins left coins and heavy unchanged.
Mason: gate 5->8 (coins 13->9), 8->10 (not 11, coins 5); Enter at gate 10 changes nothing; with 0 coins and gate 5, Enter on Mason leaves coins 0, gate 5.
Next wave Enter at tick 1206 -> play at 1207, first enemy at x=20 on tick 1267; wave 2 sent 7 walkers (Easy gate 9 -> 2); HUD 'Wave 2 of 8' / 'Oleada 2 de 8' / 'Vague 2 sur 8'.
Wave 3: 6 walkers then 4 runners, entering 72 ticks apart (2777, 2849, ... 3425); runner health 1, x drops 0.05/tick (3 u/s); runner kills took score 10->25->40 with +1 coin each.
Wave 4: 8 walkers then a brute at tick 4659 (health 6, 0.0167/tick = 1 u/s); unshot, gate 6 -> 3 when it reached the gate; shot in lane 8, health 6->4->2->gone, score 60->100, coins 977->980.
modules/work/waves.json lists each wave's walkers, runners, brutes and every (seconds), read by lib.rs (include_str, rebuilt by play); README 'Change a wave' says how.

Not reached: I could not script a run through all 8 waves with the gate standing in the time given (the builder also says the full win was never played). Score formula seen only in code (score += 20*gate).
Escape at 400 -> paused (texts Paused/Resume/Title); enemies and bolts identical at 401, 430, 459; Resume at 460 continues from those positions; Escape, down, Enter (Title) -> title screen.
Shop opening set saved true (settings.json kept.save holds wave, score, coins, gate, quick, heavy, diff, rng); next run with same folder: title texts [name, Best, Start, Continue, Settings, Quit].
Left at shop after buying Quick 1 and Heavy (coins 0, gate 5); new run, Continue -> shop with wave 1, score 0, coins 0, gate 5, quick 1, heavy 1; Next wave plays 'Wave 2 of 8'.

Start from title with a save -> saved false, no Continue afterwards (also in next run); lost run ends with saved false; Title from pause left saved true and Continue on the title. A won run's removal not seen (won not reached).
Lost run with score 10: lost screen 'Best: 10', title 'Best: 10', next run's title 'Best: 10'; a later lost run with score 0 left best 10 (lost screen 'Score: 0','Best: 10'). Won screen not reached.
Two runs seed 5, 900 ticks, same script, each from an identical copy of a settings.json: outputs byte-identical (cmp). Seed 1 vs seed 5: wave 1 lanes 6,2,6,6,2 vs 2,6,10,...

Frames at tick 4700 and 3420: brown gate on the left, blue guard at state guard_y, green cube walkers, yellow sphere runners, large red brute, white bolts at state positions (40 px/unit); HUD shows score, coins, wave, gate.
Title frame (en) Start outlined; settings frame (fr) 'Difficulté : Difficile' outlined; shop frame (es) 'Saetas pesadas...' outlined, all labels in the chosen language.
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json, one per language; ui screens use @keys; README 'Add a language' says copy en.json to <code>.json and translate.
README gives controls, says the --settings folder's settings.json keeps volume, language, difficulty, best and save, and gives play and frame commands that ran as written.

defects: State printed at tick 0 (--at 0) has null for most keys and the raw text 'Best: {work.best}'.
The play HUD panel (Score/Coins/Wave/Gate) is drawn on the title, settings and shop frames too.
The shop's selected entry on opening is inconsistent: after wave 2 it opened on Next wave (menu_index 3), after waves 1 and 3 on Quick hands.
Bolts in flight are removed when the shop opens (README admits it).
could_not_check: l21: no run through all 8 waves with the gate standing could be scripted in the judge's time; the won screen (also part of l05, l25, l26) was never seen

where.how: weighted_by_kind is exact (the run's own token counts times the weights); a step's kind is a reading of its command's text, and answered_tokens / written_tokens are characters / 4

steps.what: cd <run>/work && ls -R . | head -50 && cat notes/how.md game.json modules/*/src/lib.rs modules/*/actions.js...
cat assets/ui/title.json assets/ui/pause.json assets/ui/won.json assets/style.json | head -150; cat modules...
grep -n "pub fn\|pub enum\|pub struct" crates/specula-sdk/src/value.rs | head -50; grep -n "pub use" crates...
rm -rf checks && rm assets/ui/title.json assets/ui/pause.json assets/ui/won.json assets/ui/lost.json assets...
examen leverage play . --ticks 4 --inputs $t:enter --keys screen 2>&1 | head -3; done

trace.how: context, new, read_again and how far the context grew are the run's own records. written_out a request is its growth less its answers (characters / 4), scaled to the run's exact total; of_which_unseen is that less the visible text (thinking). cost is what the request read and wrote, weighted; carried is what reading again what it added cost at every later request (start.carried: the same for what every request starts from). reading + writing is in_the_ledger

steps.what: cd <run>; cat BRIEF.md; cat run.json; cd work; cat README.md game.json specula.project.json .gitignore; ls ...
cd <run>/work; ls modules/work modules/work/*; cat modules/work/waves.json; ls notes; wc -l modules/work/sr...
examen leverage play $G --ticks 2 --settings $S/s1 --at 0,1 --inputs 1:enter 2>&1; echo; "$E" leverage play...
cd <run>/work/assets; cat ui/settings.json ui/title.json ui/shop.json; cat strings/en.json
cd <run>/work/assets; cat strings/es.json strings/fr.json; cat ui/won.json ui/hud.json | head -60
